args.summary: Write the rollout plan in the isolated project runtime
args.code:
from pathlib import Path
home = Path.cwd().parent
assert (home / 'gui').is_dir() and (home / 'sessions').is_dir(), 'Use the isolated panel proof driver'
for sessions in (home / 'sessions').glob('v2-*'):
    plans = home / 'projects' / sessions.name / 'plans'
    plans.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = plans / 'release.md'
    path.write_text('# Atlas rollout plan\n\n1. Confirm the launch window.\n2. Stage the release and watch the metrics.\n3. Share the outcome with the team.\n')
    print(path)
